messages:
hana: Heads-up: execs want a clearer plan for the console "observability" rollout next week. They asked for prioritized scoping that balances customer asks (dashboards + traces + cost) and our delivery capacity. Quick opinions?
miles: My take: MVP should give customers fast signal-to-triage. That means cheap dashboards + tracing hooks. Detailed per-token cost and fancy error ML can wait for phase 2.
rachel: Agree. Minimal dashboard surface: 4 widgets - request rate, p95 latency, error % (by code), and daily cost per model. Must be filterable by region and model version.

hana: Nice. What about tracing? We need a minimal hook set that works for hosted and dedicated.
miles: Tracing MVP = server-side trace propagation + a sampling flag exposed in Console for canaries. Also expose trace_id in request logs so ops can jump from dashboard to trace. No distributed sampling UI yet.

tony: Cost ingestion note: the ingestion pipeline currently emits daily aggregates per model only. Per-route will need schema changes and additional storage. If we try to do per-route in MVP we'll add 2 weeks. Proposal: MVP = daily model-level cost + a small sparkline for trend. Phase 2 = per-route + breakdown by token type.
rachel: We should codify launch gates. Draft:
- Gate A: Dashboards deployed to staging with 4 widgets + filters working
- Gate B: Tracing headers flowing end-to-end in staging, and trace_id present in logs for 90% of sampled requests
- Gate C: Cost ingest pipeline writing daily model aggregates into storage and dashboards surface them
- Gate D: Acceptance smoke test & runbook published

hana: Add rollout criteria: canary to 5% traffic for 24h, then 25% for 48h, promote if no regressions and dashboard latency < 45s. Auto-rollback on 3x baseline error-rate for 10m.
miles: Also add observability SLO checks for the rollout: metrics emitted (latency, errors, cost) and a monitor that alerts if emission drops below 75% of baseline. That prevents silent gaps.

rachel: I'll own the acceptance criteria doc + runbook. Tony, can you scope the ingestion changes and give a minimal API shape for Phase 2?

ton y: (typo) whoops, meant: tony: Yup. I'll sketch the migration plan: dual-write daily model aggregates first, then opt-in per-route tagging in a follow-up. Estimate: MVP work = 1.5 dev-weeks on infra + 1 dev-week on frontend.

ci-bot: CI · console-observability · branch=feature/console-lite · build #789 · tests=56/56 · status=passed

hana: Good. Action items:
- hana: consolidate decisions into spec PR and customer-facing note (today)
- rachel: acceptance criteria + runbook (EOD)
- miles: tracing infra checklist + sampling toggle implementation plan (3 days)
- tony: ingestion plan + Phase 2 API stub (3 days)

hana: One more ask from sales: a quick demo script showing how to jump from dashboard to trace within 2 clicks. Rachel and Miles, can you collaborate on that?
rachel: Yep. I'll add a short section in the runbook and a tiny demo gif.
miles: I'll add the trace->log linking endpoint and an example curl for the demo.

hana: Thanks all. If we stick to this scope we keep the launch low-friction and still satisfy customer signal needs. Will post the spec PR and tag owners. :white_check_mark:
